entries.title: Doctor image action on the Media edit page in light mode.
entries.notes: Capture the media surface where the Doctor image action appears when an image doctor provider is bound.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens an image media record and uses the Doctor image action when an image doctor provider is bound.

entries.title: Doctor image action on the Media edit page in dark mode.
entries.notes: Dark-mode companion capture for the media surface where the Doctor image action appears when an image doctor provider is bound.
